en.title: Saudi Pipeline Restart Doubts Deepen
en.summary: The probability for the Saudi East-West oil pipeline restarting by September 30th has dropped to 18%, despite multiple September 22nd headlines reporting its restart. This decline suggests market skepticism regarding the completeness or sustainability of the reported operations, or a lack of official confirmation from Saudi Aramco.
drivers: Lack of official Aramco confirmation on full restart.
Reports of 4M bpd comeback, not full 7M bpd capacity.
Market doubts sustainability of repairs post-drone attack.
Headlines indicate 'could resume exports,' not confirmed.
en.why_matters: The pipeline's operational status is crucial for global oil supply stability, impacting crude prices and Saudi Arabia's export flexibility.
en.bull_case: Official confirmation of full, sustained 7M bpd operations by Saudi Aramco before September 30th would significantly boost probability.
en.bear_case: Continued absence of official updates or new reports of operational setbacks before the deadline.

zh.title: 沙特输油管重启存疑加深
zh.summary: 尽管9月22日多条新闻报道沙特东西向输油管道已重启，但该管道在9月30日前重启的概率已降至18%。这一下降表明市场对报道中运营的完整性或可持续性存在疑虑，或缺乏沙特阿美公司的官方确认。
drivers: 缺乏沙特阿美公司对全面重启的官方确认。
报道称恢复400万桶/日，而非700万桶/日满负荷。
市场质疑无人机袭击后修复的可持续性。
新闻标题仅表示“可能恢复出口”，而非已确认。
zh.why_matters: 该管道的运营状况对全球石油供应稳定至关重要，影响原油价格及沙特规避霍尔木兹海峡的能力。
zh.bull_case: 沙特阿美在9月30日前官方确认全面、持续的700万桶/日运营。
zh.bear_case: 截止日期前持续缺乏官方更新或出现新的运营挫折报告。
